estimands.outcome: hfh_cvd_recurrent: recurrent hospitalisations for heart failure together with cardiovascular death, as a rate ratio
estimands.timepoint: from randomisation to each contributing trial's own follow-up
estimands.missing_data_model: Use each trial's own analysis set as stored; some are smaller than the randomised total and others equal it. No rebuild-level imputation is imposed.

estimands.outcome: hfh_cvd_first: time to a first cardiovascular death or hospitalisation for heart failure, as a hazard ratio
estimands.timepoint: from randomisation to each contributing trial's own follow-up
estimands.missing_data_model: Use each trial's own analysis set as stored; no conversion from recurrent-event estimates and no rebuild-level imputation.

estimands.outcome: hfh_recurrent: recurrent hospitalisations for heart failure alone, with no death component, as a rate ratio
estimands.timepoint: from randomisation to each contributing trial's own follow-up
estimands.missing_data_model: Use each trial's own analysis set as stored; no rebuild-level imputation is imposed.

estimands.outcome: acm: time to death from any cause, as a hazard ratio
estimands.timepoint: from randomisation to each contributing trial's own follow-up
estimands.missing_data_model: Use each trial's own analysis set as stored; no rebuild-level imputation is imposed.

estimands.outcome: six_min_walk_24w: change in six-minute walk distance at the primary timepoint, in metres
estimands.timepoint: baseline to the trial primary timepoint; CONFIRM-HF contributes the week-24 value
estimands.missing_data_model: Use the trial's full-analysis-set mean-difference estimate; no rebuild-level imputation is imposed.

harmonisation_rule.harmonised_endpoint: None across outcome families. Pool only within the same outcome concept, effect measure and unit of analysis; keep recurrent rates, time-to-first hazards, mean differences and win-ratio reporting separate.

eligibility.population: adults with heart failure and iron deficiency
eligibility.intervention: intravenous iron as ferric carboxymaltose or ferric derisomaltose
eligibility.comparator_kind_note: The object-level criterion is mixed placebo or usual care; protocol_schema_v2 has no mixed or usual-care enum, so the allowed typed value is paired with the explicit comparator text.

statistics.small_k_ci_rule: Use generic inverse variance on the logged ratio scale where the effect is a ratio and REML for random-effects pools. For small k, report the HKSJ t_{k-1} interval with a variance-inflation floor of 1 alongside the ordinary interval, and do not present the narrower interval as the sole precision claim.

disclosure_clause.text: This is a retrospective methods record. Before these methods were written, a page for this topic had already been served, and the headline recurrent-composite result was knowable as k=2 with pooled rate ratio 0.8066 and 95% CI 0.6856 to 0.9488. Writing this protocol now is disclosure for a rebuild, not pre-specification.

absolute_effect.control_risk_source: No absolute-effect control risk is recorded in the target object for these summary-effect estimands; do not infer one during registration.

governance.registering_commit_sha_note: git rev-parse HEAD did not resolve a commit in this checkout.
governance.supersedes_why: The existing object protocol states that no prespecified protocol can be created retrospectively; this schema-v2 record is therefore explicitly retrospective and only governs a rebuild.

schema_excluded_reporting_outcomes.outcome: hierarchical_primary: hierarchical composite of death, heart-failure hospitalisations and change in walk distance, as an unmatched win ratio
schema_excluded_reporting_outcomes.reason: The target object reports this as a single-study, non-pooled win-ratio outcome, but protocol_schema_v2 has no win-ratio effect_measure enum. It is retained as reporting-only here and must not be forced into HR, RR, OR or MD pooling.
